comparison.objective: Strip 10 mm of insulation from a cable in a lever-operated station.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert cable to depth, hold a cutting lever closed, and pull the cable out while blades remain engaged.
comparison.success_condition: An 8–12 mm strip is produced and lever and hands are released; premature lever release leaves insulation attached.
comparison.reason: Both remove a sacrificial remnant and require bimanual force sequencing, but stripping tests sustained blade closure plus linear pull on deformable insulation. The candidate tests hammer-driven notch fracture, coil preservation, and independent recovery of four free tangs.
